# R (refuse) or A (allow), a space, then the Bash command. Runs with AGENTIC_SDLC_GATE_WIDE='npm test|pytest|tests/run\.sh'.
R npm test
R cd app && pytest -x
R sh tests/run.sh
A npm run test:fast
A git status
A plugin/bin/gate wide npm test
A gate wide -- sh tests/run.sh
R plugin/bin/gate wide true; npm test
R gate wide true && npm test
R gate wide true | npm test
R gate wide true<NL>npm test
R echo gate wide; npm test
R sh tests/run.sh # gate wide
R gate wide true $(npm test)
R gate wide true `npm test`
R gate wide tee >(npm test)
R gate wide cat <(npm test)
